messages:
Aisha Khan: hey team — first day! trying to spin up a test VM in asia-east4 for latency checks but getting a 403 when I try to add the serviceAccount to the instance. I also don't see any billing accounts to attach. who should I ping for region/billing perms?

Charles Li: welcome Aisha :wave:  most likely org-policy or billing link. pinging @Leo (cloud-ops) to check quotas and billing. did you create the project yourself or was it a sandbox?

Aisha Khan: created project 'redwood-aisha-dev' via quickstart. I ran: `gcloud compute instances create test-1 --zone=asia-east4-a` and got `ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.create) Could not fetch resource: (403) Permission 'compute.instances.create' denied`.

Leo (cloud-ops): looking now. two quick asks: 1) can you paste `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-aisha-dev --format=json` (redact emails if needed) and 2) run `gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-aisha-dev`?

Aisha Khan: paste snippet: ```{ "bindings": [{"role":"roles/viewer","members":["group:redwood-devs@redwood.com"]}], "etag":"BwWW..." }```

Infra Bot: orgPolicy violation detected for project redwood-aisha-dev: constraint constraints/gcp.resourceLocations prevents resource creation in asia-east4. See https://redwood.internal/docs/org-policies for remediation.

Emma R.: fyi we recently tightened allowed regions for cost/compliance. new regions must be approved by infra. for now devs should use asia-southeast1 or us-west2. if you need asia-east4 for perf testing, please file the region-request form: https://go.redwood/region-request — include justification + traffic estimate.

Charles Li: if billing missing, @Leo can attach the central dev billing account. also for AWS cross-account access we have a role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Dev-Assume` — ping me if you need that added.

Leo (cloud-ops): added billing account `redwood-dev-billing` to your project and created a temporary sandbox project `dev-sandbox-aisha` with permissions. asia-east4 still blocked by orgPolicy; I submitted an infra exception request (INC-4723) — approval ETA EOD. In the meantime you can run tests in `asia-southeast1` in the sandbox. I'll DM you sandbox service account creds (or use Okta app).

Aisha Khan: awesome, thanks! how do I switch to the sandbox project in gcloud quickly? any recommended flags for perf tests so I don't get billed too much?

Emma R.: `gcloud config set project dev-sandbox-aisha` and use smaller instance types for perf smoke. put `--preemptible` and limit disk size. also use our internal cost tag `--labels=owner=aisha,team=eng` so finance can track. I'll DM the 1Password path for the SA key.

Charles Li: quick note — if you need to assume cross-account AWS role later, I can add your Okta group. :thumbsup:

Aisha Khan: great, appreciate the fast help everyone! I'll try the sandbox and file the region request if needed.

Leo (cloud-ops): added you to `redwood-devs` and `okta-gcp-sandbox` groups. ping here if anything else blocks.
